profileEvidence.author: A
profileEvidence.summary: Affectionate and even-tempered, the Artois Hound is a vigorous hunter with a close attachment to familiar people and a sociable pack nature. A fine nose and careful persistence help it work hare, deer and boar, while its high hunting voice carries over distance. Once thought lost after the Second World War, the breed was rebuilt in the Somme during the 1970s.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An affectionate, sociable pack hound, the Artois combines a fine nose with determined hunting and a far-carrying voice.
